changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS m_client_kyc_decision ( id BIGINT NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, kyc_verification_id BIGINT NOT NULL, decision_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, decision_workflow_id VARCHAR(255), decision_created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, created_by BIGINT NOT NULL, created_on_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, last_modified_by BIGINT NOT NULL, last_modified_on_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_m_client_kyc_decision PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_kyc_decision_verification FOREIGN KEY (kyc_verification_id) REFERENCES m_client_kyc_verification(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_kyc_decision_created_by FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES m_appuser(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT fk_kyc_decision_last_modified_by FOREIGN KEY (last_modified_by) REFERENCES m_appuser(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_kyc_decision_verification ON m_client_kyc_decision(kyc_verification_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_kyc_feature_decision ON m_client_kyc_decision_feature(kyc_decision_id);
